label: Portfolio
description: Portfolio website templates for designers, freelancers and studios. Compare project pages, CMS features and live demos, then publish in Framer.
lead: Show your work, explain what you do and make contact easy. Open a template to compare its project pages and live demo.
include: A short line that says what you do and who you work with
Three to six case studies, not every project you ever made
An about section with your experience and services
One clear way to get in touch

faq.q: What should a portfolio website include?
faq.a: Your best projects, a short introduction, your services and a clear contact option. Three to six strong projects usually work better than a long list.

faq.q: Can I add new projects later?
faq.a: Yes, in templates with a CMS. You add a project as a new item, and its page and list entry follow the template design.

label: Agency
description: Agency website templates with projects, services and team sections. Compare the pages and live demos, then publish in Framer.
lead: Present your studio, your services and the work behind them. Open a template to compare its pages and live demo.
include: A clear statement of what the agency does
Selected projects with results
Services and how you work
The team and a contact form

faq.q: What pages does an agency website need?
faq.a: Most agencies need a home page, projects, services, an about page and contact. Add a blog only if you will keep it updated.

label: SaaS and app
seoTitle: SaaS and App Website Templates for Framer and Astro
description: Website templates for SaaS products and mobile apps, with pricing, features and support pages. Use them in Framer or buy the code.
lead: Launch a product site with the pages people look for first: features, pricing and support. Every template here is also available as Astro code.
include: One sentence that explains the product
Screens of the real product
Features written as benefits
Pricing, support and legal pages

faq.q: What should a SaaS landing page include?
faq.a: A clear headline, product screens, key features, pricing and one main call to action. Add answers to the questions people ask before they sign up.

faq.q: Can I use these templates without Framer?
faq.a: Yes. Templates in this category also come as Astro and Tailwind CSS code, which you can host on any static host.

label: AI
description: Website templates for AI tools and products. Compare the pages and live demos, then publish in Framer.
lead: Explain what your AI product does and show it working. Open a template to compare its pages and live demo.
include: What the tool does, in plain words
A real example of its output
Pricing and a changelog
How you handle customer data

faq.q: What should an AI product website show?
faq.a: Show what goes in and what comes out, who the tool is for and what it costs. A real example explains more than a list of features.
